title: Our Future Health — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; context-specific sentinels are inlined per field because their meanings differ by variable.

prefer_not_to_answer.title: Prefer not to answer
prefer_not_to_answer.description: The participant chose not to answer. Adopted from the source's own codings (coded -3 on 347 questionnaire codings and 5 participant codings), not invented — D003.

dont_know.title: Do not know
dont_know.description: The participant did not know the answer. Adopted from the source's own codings (coded -1 on 280 questionnaire codings) — D003.

dont_remember.title: Do not remember
dont_remember.description: The participant did not remember. Adopted from the source's own codings (coded -4 on 4 questionnaire codings) — D003.

suppressed.title: Suppressed
suppressed.description: The value is withheld by the data provider. Adopted from the source's own codings (coded -999 on 10 questionnaire and 2 participant codings) — D003.

not_shown.title: Question not shown
not_shown.description: The questionnaire routing did not show this question to the participant. The source's raw tables hold NULL here (the logic file: "If the field is null in the dataset, the question was not shown"); the package records it in-band as -998, an agent-proposed code the steward ratified on 2026-09-19 — D021.

not_recorded.title: Not recorded
not_recorded.description: The measurement, or the reason for skipping it, is absent in the source (NULL) because the participant skipped the measurement, or the reason does not apply. The same in-band code as not_shown (D021), named for a measurement instead of a question — D088.

not_recorded_text.title: Not recorded
not_recorded_text.description: The value is absent (NULL) in the source. The string form of the package's -998 code, used where the value itself is text, so that the cell keeps its type — D101.
